Tools for the M-VAVE Chocolate Plus

Configure your Chocolate Plus MIDI foot controller right in the browser, and give it a custom firmware with faster footswitches, an informative startup screen and a clearer bank display.

Web Config

Set up your pedal without installing anything.

  • Edit the modes, the messages of every switch and the banks.
  • Connects over Bluetooth in Chrome or Edge, on the computer or on Android.
  • Shows which firmware version is installed on the pedal.
Open Web Config ↗

Custom Firmware 141

An improved firmware for the pedal, flashed with the SincoOTA app.

  • Faster footswitches; short, quick taps are no longer missed.
  • On startup the screen shows the version, the battery level and the selected mode.
  • Clearer bank display in advanced custom mode.
  • Dimmed status LED.
